title: SpaceAct: Benchmarking 3D Spatial and Temporal Reasoning via Closed-Loop Action and Active Perception
abstract: arXiv:2610.38405v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To solve problems in 3D space rather than merely describe images, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) need 3D spatiotemporal reasoning: reconstructing 3D geometry from occluded 2D views, anticipating physical dynamics, and executing precise, closed-loop actions. Prior studies test passive VQA on static images or symbolic planning, requiring no execution or supplying privileged coordinates while ignoring collision, statics, and timing. We introduce SpaceAct, an interactive benchmark evaluating 3D spatiotemporal reasoning via closed-loop physical action and active perception, with SAPA, a Spatiotemporal Active-Probing Agent framework. Built on interlocking bricks and mechanical puzzles, it has 108 verified instances across 36 task families in six categories, without privileged coordinates, and diagnostic modes (+plan, +state, no-camera, blind, L7 levers). translated_title: SpaceAct：通过闭环动作与主动感知对三维空间与时间推理进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 为了让多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够解决三维空间中的问题，而不仅仅是描述图像，它们需要具备三维时空推理能力：从被遮挡的二维视角重建三维几何结构、预判物理动态，并执行精确的闭环动作。以往的研究要么在静态图像上进行被动的视觉问答（VQA）测试，要么进行符号规划，既不需要实际执行动作，又会提供特权坐标，同时忽略了碰撞、静力学与时机等因素。我们提出SpaceAct，一个通过闭环物理动作与主动感知来评估三维时空推理能力的交互式基准，并配套提出SAPA——一种时空主动探测代理框架。该基准基于互锁积木和机械谜题构建，涵盖六大类别、36个任务族共108个经过核验的实例，不提供特权坐标，并设有多种诊断模式（+plan、+state、no-camera、blind、L7 levers）。在积木搭桥或穿孔穿线等任务中，模型需要旋转相机来化解遮挡……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了SpaceAct交互式基准与SAPA时空主动探测代理框架，在无特权坐标的条件下，通过闭环物理动作与主动感知来评估多模态大语言模型的三维时空推理能力。
en_tdlr: SpaceAct introduces an interactive benchmark with the SAPA Spatiotemporal Active-Probing Agent framework that evaluates MLLMs' 3D spatiotemporal reasoning through closed-loop physical action and active perception, without privileged coordinates.
